# Buildings AI Developer Kit

> Agent-ready documentation for the Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Building Data Platform APIs (REST API, GraphQL API, Event Hubs), generated from the official product documentation. Documentation only: this kit contains no live data.

Calling the APIs requires authentication (see the Authentication pages). Live building data is only available through the authenticated APIs or the separate, authenticated API MCP server, never through this kit. Examples use fictional identifiers.

## Example API

- [Legacy Widgets](https://schneiderelectricbuildings.github.io/buildings-ai-devkit/content/api/endpoints/legacy-widgets.md): (deprecated) Placeholder deprecated endpoint, used to test how deprecated pages are labelled.
- [Sites](https://schneiderelectricbuildings.github.io/buildings-ai-devkit/content/api/endpoints/sites.md): Placeholder endpoint page listing and retrieving sites in the Example API.
- [Authentication](https://schneiderelectricbuildings.github.io/buildings-ai-devkit/content/api/overview/authentication.md): Placeholder page describing how a client obtains a bearer token for the Example API.
- [Introduction](https://schneiderelectricbuildings.github.io/buildings-ai-devkit/content/api/overview/introduction.md): Placeholder overview of the Example API, used to develop the kit's generators before real content is exported.

## Guides

- [Make your first request](https://schneiderelectricbuildings.github.io/buildings-ai-devkit/content/guides/first-request.md): Placeholder walkthrough from authentication to a first successful call to the Example API.
